commands:
mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
if rm -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled" 2>/dev/null &&
   git status --porcelain -z > ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" &&
   [ -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
   [ ! -L ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
   git hash-object ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before"; then
  :
else
  echo "::warning::snapshot failed" >&2
  printf '%s\n' disabled > ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled"
fi

.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/load-prompt-extension.sh requesting-code-review 2>/tmp/ext.err >/tmp/ext.out; echo "EXIT=$?"; echo "---STDOUT bytes---"; wc -c </tmp/ext.out; echo "---STDOUT---"; cat /tmp/ext.out; echo "---STDERR---"; cat /tmp/ext.err

ls .changeset/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; for f in $(git ls-files '.changeset/*.md' | grep -v README | head -3); do echo "== $f =="; head -6 "$f"; done; echo "=== consolidate parser ==="; grep -rn "bump\|^---" scripts/consolidate-changesets.py 2>/dev/null | head

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
